instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ahmed Shakir Abd Al-Rida
subject: 03_Data_Mining

questions.question: What does accuracy measure?
options: the percentage of all predictions that are correct
patterns that distinguish one class from another
Continue splitting until every record is isolated.
when the classes have identical names
options_en: the percentage of all predictions that are correct
patterns that distinguish one class from another
Continue splitting until every record is isolated.
when the classes have identical names
options_ar: يواصل التقسيم حتى عزل كل سجل.
questions.explanation: Accuracy measures the percentage of all predictions that are correct.

questions.question: If a model correctly classifies 95 of 100 patients, what accuracy is reported?
questions.question_ar: إذا صنّف نموذج 95 مريضاً من أصل 100 بصورة صحيحة، فما الدقة؟

questions.question: Which question does precision answer?
questions.question_ar: عن أي سؤال تجيب قيمة Precision؟
options: High accuracy guarantees that every minority case is found.
The model should not use the test data during training.
Of all actual positives, how many did the model identify?
When the model predicts positive, how often is it correct?
options_en: High accuracy guarantees that every minority case is found.
The model should not use the test data during training.
Of all actual positives, how many did the model identify?
When the model predicts positive, how often is it correct?
options_ar: تضمن الدقة العالية العثور على كل حالة من الفئة الأقلية.
ينبغي ألا يستخدم النموذج بيانات الاختبار أثناء التدريب.
من كل الإيجابيات الفعلية، كم حالة حددها النموذج؟
عندما يتنبأ النموذج بالإيجابية، كم مرة يكون تنبؤه صحيحاً؟
questions.explanation: When the model predicts positive, how often is it correct?
questions.explanation_ar: عندما يتنبأ النموذج بالإيجابية، كم مرة يكون تنبؤه صحيحاً؟

questions.question: The model predicts disease in 100 patients and 90 actually have it. What precision is reported?
questions.question_ar: يتنبأ النموذج بالمرض لدى 100 مريض، و90 منهم مصابون فعلاً. ما قيمة Precision؟

questions.question: When should precision be prioritized?
options: when missing a positive case is the only concern
when false positive predictions are costly
when every class has equal frequency
What percentage of all predictions is correct?
options_en: when missing a positive case is the only concern
when false positive predictions are costly
when every class has equal frequency
What percentage of all predictions is correct?
options_ar: عندما يكون تفويت حالة موجبة هو مصدر القلق الوحيد
عندما تكون التنبؤات الإيجابية الكاذبة مكلفة
عندما تكون جميع الفئات متساوية التكرار
ما نسبة التنبؤات الصحيحة من جميع التنبؤات؟
questions.explanation: Precision is important when false positive predictions are costly.
questions.explanation_ar: عندما تكون التنبؤات الإيجابية الكاذبة مكلفة

questions.question: Recall asks about cases of which kind?
questions.question_ar: عن أي نوع من الحالات يسأل Recall؟
questions.explanation: Of all the cases that are actually positive, how many did the model correctly identify?

questions.question: The model correctly identifies 95 of 100 patients who actually have a disease. What recall is reported?
questions.question_ar: يحدد النموذج 95 مريضاً من أصل 100 مصاب فعلياً بالمرض. ما قيمة Recall؟

questions.question: When is recall especially important?
questions.question_ar: متى يكون Recall مهماً بصورة خاصة؟
questions.explanation: Recall is especially important when missing a positive case can have serious consequences.

questions.question: Specificity asks about cases of which kind?
questions.question_ar: عن أي نوع من الحالات تسأل Specificity؟
questions.explanation: Of all the cases that are actually negative, how many did the model correctly identify?

questions.question: A model correctly identifies 90 of 100 healthy patients. What specificity is reported?
questions.question_ar: يحدد النموذج 90 شخصاً سليماً من أصل 100 بصورة صحيحة. ما قيمة Specificity؟

questions.question: Which two measures does F1-score combine?
questions.explanation: F1-score combines precision and recall into one measure.

questions.question: What does the ROC curve evaluate across?
questions.question_ar: على ماذا يقيّم منحنى ROC النموذج؟
questions.explanation: It evaluates the model at different decision thresholds.

questions.question: What does an AUC of 0.50 indicate?
questions.question_ar: إلى ماذا تشير قيمة AUC البالغة 0.50؟
